Name: prepare_data.py
Schedule / Trigger: Pi cron — daily 02:00 UTC (every day incl. weekends)
How to Run: python3 prepare_data.py — DuckDB only: python3 prepare_data.py --materialise-only
Technical Notes: Runs daily including weekends to capture month-end data. After materialise curls /api/warm to rebuild dashboard caches. duckdb CLI must be on PATH (/usr/local/bin).

Name: zoho_industry.py
Data Out: Zoho CRM account industry field updates
Technical Notes: Weekdays only (Mon–Fri). Syncs industry classifications from TryBooking into Zoho CRM. OAuth2 refresh token flow.

Name: zoho_tiers.py
Data Out: Zoho CRM tier field updates; CSV to reports/; retention priority written to SQLite
Technical Notes: v2 tier algorithm: 55% current 12m revenue + 35% lifetime revenue + 10% years loyalty. Bands: T1 top 2%, T2 3–10%, T3 11–25%, T4 26–50%, T5 51–100%. Writes retention_priority to SQLite — triggers second DuckDB materialise at 03:30.

Name: s3_to_sharepoint.py
Data Out: SharePoint folder mirror (ETag-based — only changed files)
Technical Notes: ETag-based sync. Manifest persists at /root/s3reporting/.sync_manifest. Requires AZURE_TENANT_ID, AZURE_CLIENT_ID, AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET, AZURE_SENDER_MAILBOX.

Name: backup_to_sharepoint.py
Data Out: SharePoint Backups/pi/YYYY-MM-DD/ — keeps last 7 dated copies
Technical Notes: Runs after the 03:30 re-materialise so backup includes same-day data. Restore with restore_from_sharepoint.py.

Name: prepare_data.py (re-materialise)
Technical Notes: Second daily DuckDB build — runs after zoho_tiers so retention_priority is same-day in the dashboard. Weekdays only.

Name: weekly_reporting_unified.py
Data Out: Email HTML report to stakeholders; CSV to reports/
How to Run: python3 weekly_reporting_unified.py — test mode: export TEST_MODE=1 first
Technical Notes: New account analysis with year-on-year comparisons. TEST_MODE redirects email to test recipients. TEST_DATE overrides processing date. Email via Azure Graph API (Mailgun SMTP fallback).

Name: salesiq_weekly.py
Technical Notes: Weekly chat summary. Runs 5 minutes before weekly_reporting_unified.py. Email via Azure Graph API.

Name: monthly_reporting.py
Schedule / Trigger: Pi cron — 1st of each month 09:00 UTC
Data Out: Email HTML report; CSV to reports/
Technical Notes: Monthly performance report for the previous month. S3 monthly files land on the 1st; new-month files appear on the 2nd — so the 1st always reads the previous month.

Name: sales_commission_report.py
Schedule / Trigger: Pi cron — 2nd of each month 09:00 UTC
Data Out: Email PDF + HTML report; CSV to reports/
How to Run: python3 sales_commission_report.py — override month: export REPORT_MONTH=YYYY-MM first
Technical Notes: Monthly commission calculation for the sales team. Config: sales_commission_config.json (flat fee + % per person). Email via Azure Graph API.

Name: weekly_domain_report.py
Technical Notes: Extracts and counts email domains from user data. Useful for acquisition channel analysis.

Name: eoy_planning_report.py
Data In: S3: Accounts, BookingData, BookingDataAll; GA4 API
Data Out: CSVs to planning/, seasonality/, industry/, cohorts/, geography/, keywords/
How to Run: python3 eoy_planning_report.py — modes: rolling / year_2025 / year_2024 / custom / monthly_review
Technical Notes: Comprehensive metrics for target modelling. Multiple output modes. Requires GA4_PROPERTY_ID and GA4_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY.

Name: industry_analysis.py
Technical Notes: Industry and revenue distribution analysis. Account-level and period-level breakdowns.

Name: ppc_reporting.py
How to Run: python3 ppc_reporting.py — test mode: export TEST_MODE=1 first. Config: config/ppc_campaigns.json
Technical Notes: PPC campaign conversion and revenue attribution from 2024-06-01 to today. Requires GA4_PROPERTY_ID and GA4_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY.

Name: regional_segmentation.py
Technical Notes: UK regional distribution of accounts and events by postcode area.

Name: analyse_wales_ni_sectors.py
Technical Notes: Industry sector analysis for Wales and Northern Ireland accounts.

Name: keyword_analysis_report.py
Technical Notes: Event keyword/type frequency analysis (e.g. balls, concerts, musicals). Logic in modules/event_keyword_analysis.py.

Name: salesiq_monthly_report.py
How to Run: python3 salesiq_monthly_report.py — set YEAR env var to override year
Technical Notes: Historical/annual SalesIQ chat statistics by year. Separate from the weekly report.

Name: pricing_scenarios_2026.py
Data Out: CSVs: online, stripe, box_office_card scenarios to output/
Technical Notes: Revenue modelling under different fee structures. Scenario groups defined in pricing_scenarios.yml. Intended to be made generic for future years.

Name: pricing_model_comparison.py
How to Run: python3 pricing_model_comparison.py — set YEAR env var to select year
Technical Notes: Pricing scenario comparison across models. Use alongside pricing_scenarios_2026.py.

Name: event_completion_reminders.py
Data In: S3: Accounts, BookingData, Users, RiskReport; Vero API
Data Out: Vero user tags; CSV audit trail
How to Run: python3 event_completion_reminders.py — test mode: export TEST_MODE=1. Override date: export TEST_DATE=YYYY-MM-DD
Technical Notes: Sends behavioural reminders via GetVero after event completion. TEST_MODE skips live Vero writes. API client: modules/utils/vero_api.py.

Name: funds_remaining_reminder.py
Data In: S3: Accounts, Users, RiskReport; Vero API
How to Run: python3 funds_remaining_reminder.py — test mode: export TEST_MODE=1
Technical Notes: Tags users with remaining funds from past events for re-engagement campaigns. TEST_MODE skips live Vero writes.

Name: zoho_tiers_v2.py
Data Out: CSV: tier_output.csv + summary stats (no Zoho writes)
Technical Notes: Dry-run tier calculation — preview tier changes before running zoho_tiers.py.

Name: compare_tiers.py
Technical Notes: Compares tier calculation outputs. Run after zoho_tiers_v2.py to validate before going live.

Name: check_account_names.py
Data In: names.txt input file; S3: Accounts, BookingData
How to Run: python3 check_account_names.py (requires names.txt in working directory)
Technical Notes: Fuzzy-matches a list of account names against S3 data. Useful for deduplication and account identification.

Name: account_box_office_cardpresent.py
Data Out: Console + CSV output for a single account
Technical Notes: Box Office card-present revenue breakdown for a single account over the rolling 365 days.

Name: test_ppc_setup.py
Technical Notes: Validates AWS credentials and GA4 config before running ppc_reporting.py. Safe to run anytime.

Name: test_vero_api.py
Technical Notes: Validates Vero API connectivity and module behaviour. Runs in test mode — no live writes.

Name: restore_from_sharepoint.py
How to Run: python3 restore_from_sharepoint.py --list — then: python3 restore_from_sharepoint.py --date YYYY-MM-DD
Technical Notes: Restores Pi state from SharePoint backups made by backup_to_sharepoint.py. Always run --list first to see available dates.

Name: box_office_excel/build_workbook.py
Data Out: BoxOfficeTerminals.xlsx (open in Excel to add VBA, save as .xlsm)
Technical Notes: Generates the Box Office Terminals workbook structure. VBA (box_office_excel/vba/) handles business rules and must be added manually in Excel. No regulated data involved.
